caption: The drawing depicts a circular chandelier composed of a wagon wheel structure, suspended from a ceiling by a series of twisted metal chains. The chandelier consists of a large, dark-shaded wheel with eight evenly spaced spokes radiating from a central hub. Attached to the outer rim of the wheel are eight light fixtures, each designed with a textured, cylindrical shade that appears to be glass or metal mesh, and each fixture is affixed to the wheel at the end of a short mount. The chains, which are rendered in a slightly lighter shade than the wheel, are looped through clamps or hooks on the wheel and converge at a central point above the chandelier before twisting upward to connect to a ceiling hook or mounting piece. The entire composition features a monotone, grayscale palette created with pencil shading, and the background is a plain, light-colored surface that highlights the chandelier as the central subject of the drawing.
title: Chandelier
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
